data.title: GASTAT: Saudi Arabia's Date Production Rises 7.6%, Exceeds Two Million Tons in 2025
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- Total date production in the Kingdom increased by 7.6% in 2025 compared with 2024, exceeding two million tons, while the number of palm trees reached 37.9 million, including 34.7 million fruit-bearing trees, according to a bulletin issued by the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT).
    The results showed that the area planted with open-field vegetables reached 94,400 hectares, with production totaling around 2.9 million tons, an increase of 5.5% compared with 2024. Potatoes led crop output at approximately 653,000 tons.
    The GASTAT bulletin also reported that protected vegetable production reached about 828,000 tons in 2025, an increase of 3.8% compared with 2024.
    Regarding foreign trade, the bulletin showed that agricultural exports increased by 21.5% to 614,000 tons, of which edible fruits accounted for 69.3%. Imports of crops also increased by 7.7% compared with 2024, reaching 20.2 million tons, with cereals accounting for 74.2%.
    -- SPA
